nonblocking_limitations: Individual compiler caps sum to 5040s, exceeding 3600s aggregate. This is intentionally bounded by hard aggregate deadline; later products may remain unrun if earlier stages consume their caps.

30s nominal cleanup/postguard reserve is conservative: verify() calls budget.remaining() against work_deadline, so postguards reaching the reserve fail rather than consume it. This does not allow overrun or unsafe success; it may reject a build near its work deadline.
All filesystem source/path/ABI conclusions are scoped to pinned proposal bytes. Compiler success, actual link maps, complete numerical equality and performance are not established by source review.
